exposure: Second stage cesarean section in first pregnancy
outcome: Mode of birth in subsequent pregnancy
cohort: 81 mothers who had a vacuum extraction or second stage cesarean section in their first pregnancy at Mulago National Referral Hospital, Uganda, between November 2014 and July 2015
finding: Women who had a vacuum extraction in their first pregnancy had significantly higher rates of vaginal birth in their subsequent pregnancy compared to those who had a second stage cesarean section.
mod_finding: Vacuum extraction in the first pregnancy was associated with a higher rate of vaginal birth in the subsequent pregnancy compared to second stage cesarean section.
